function: Learned (DDPG) design of vehicle transmit beamformers for sensing and over-the-air-computation communication signals, maximizing uplink sum rate under sensing-rate, aggregation-MSE and power constraints (pp. 7-9).
system: K=2 vehicles with M=2 antennas, RSU with Nt=Nr=8 antennas, uplink ISAC with AirFL aggregation, 28 GHz carrier, 800 MHz bandwidth, no RIS (pp. 4, 11).
method: DDPG actor-critic DRL (continuous actions) producing beamformers; aggregation beamformer from SDR plus Gaussian randomization fed as state input; trained by interaction, 10000 episodes of 100 steps (pp. 7-11).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh CN(0,1) fading, path loss 32.4+20log10(fc)+30log10(d) dB and 7.8 dB shadowing from 3GPP TR 38.901, 28 GHz; no dataset or measurement (p. 11).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation in the same simulated setup (K=2, M=2, Nt=Nr=8); sweeps of power, antennas, vehicles, learning rate and discount factor; no unseen-scenario test (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Learned: TD3, deep Q learning with quantized actions; greedy Q-value selection. Non-learned: random action selection. No classical optimization baseline (pp. 11-13).
metrics: Cumulative reward per episode, achievable sum rate (bit/s/Hz), sensing estimation rate, CDF of the sum rate (pp. 11-13).
complexity: Time order O(sum of actor and critic layer-width products) + O(G(s)) (Eq. 49) and space order (Eq. 50); no runtime or FLOPs (pp. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 11: "following Rayleigh fading, modeled as complex". Rayleigh CN(0,1) small-scale fading; only the path loss and 7.8 dB shadowing come from 3GPP TR 38.901 [55]; no full 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 11: "We set the numbers of vehicles as K = 2, and transmit". One default setup; Figs. 6, 8-10 sweep power, antennas and vehicles; the generalization claim on p. 3 is not tested and no fine-tuning or transfer is reported.
q3_support: p. 11: "Random: Agent randomly selects the action at from the" discrete set. Non-learned: random selection; learned: TD3 and deep Q learning on the same problem; compared on sum rate in Figs. 6 and 10 (pp. 12-13).
q4_support: p. 10: "The complexity of Algorithm 2 learning process correlates" with the networks and replay memory; time and space orders are given in Eqs. 49-50 (p. 11).
q5_support: p. 11: "are simulated on the workstation with Nvidia GTX 1080 Ti". Simulated data in Python and PyTorch; no link, DOI, repository or data-availability statement.
notes: Included as area 5, not 7: the DDPG outputs the vehicles' sensing and communication transmit beamformers to maximize the sum rate under sensing-rate, aggregation-MSE and power constraints (p. 7); the AirFL aggregation beamformer comes from SDR and Gaussian randomization (pp. 8-9), and no federated learning accuracy results are reported. Reviewer may weigh area 7 because the communication symbols carry AirFL model weights (p. 4). q1: path loss and shadowing follow TR 38.901 but fading is Rayleigh, which the rules say does not count. q3: the only non-learned baseline is random action selection, with no classical optimization baseline; reviewer to confirm.
